description: Web app (standalone HTML, or an SPA in React/Vue/vanilla + Vite) — merges the old web-app-spa and web-app-standalone-html plugins into one, authored via the scaffold-authoring system (SK-ADR-003).

help.name: Web App
help.details: Choose one appType during init: a single, dependency-free standalone HTML file (no server, no network after load), or a Vite-powered single-page app in React, Vue, or plain vanilla TS (client-side routing-ready, no SSR). vitest + eslint are wired in for every SPA choice, regardless of framework. Replaces the old web-app-spa/web-app-standalone-html plugins — same generated output per choice, one merged plugin.

questions.message: Author (optional, used for package.json and an MIT LICENSE)

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2023",
    "lib": [
      "ES2023",
      "DOM",
      "DOM.Iterable"
    ],
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "Bundler",
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "strict": true,
    "noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "noEmit": true
  },
  "include": [
    "src/**/*.ts",
    "src/**/*.tsx",
    "vite.config.ts"
  ]
}
